scope: All six retained GrowthTrack GLBs, runtime model selection and the 1–75 3D checkpoint

models.retainedOriginalGeometry: Positions, normals, UVs, indices, morph deltas, images and active skin influences were compared before/after normalization. Zero-weight joint slots were normalized to joint zero without changing weighted influences.
formatRepairs: POSITION bounds, including sparse morph accessors
Tangent frames for normal-mapped legacy primitives
Empty node children removed while retaining nodes and joints
Unsupported mesh properties moved under extras
models.sourceChain: Original four assets remain pinned by feature-topology-repair.json. format-repair.json pins the before/after hashes and current integrity; the tests compare the current original attribute, morph, rig and image payloads to those records without requiring local backup GLBs. Preview-75 files were rebuilt from normalized assessed sources. Pre-format backup bytes remain local.

runtimeRepairs.issue: Explicitly selected bundled GLBs skipped eyelid, brow and pose-binding preparation.
runtimeRepairs.fix: Apply bundled corrections based on the reviewed asset registry, independent of selection source; keep unrecognized owner uploads outside the bundled correction path.

runtimeRepairs.issue: Legacy eyelashes intersected the closed eyelid.
runtimeRepairs.fix: Hide bundled eyelash cards above the JSON-configured near-closed blink threshold and restore them as the eyes reopen.

browserReview.captureRetention: Eight representative full preview views are retained in Git. All 54 captures remain on disk; the remaining views and duplicate browser output are ignored.

verification.targetedEslint: passed with the existing TypeScript E2E file ignored by ESLint configuration
verification.productionBuild: passed; existing Three.js chunk-size warning remains

visualAssessment.result: Consistent human-shaped full-body and face silhouette across front, rear, side and turned views; full and lite render paths match.
visualAssessment.limitation: Close views remain stylized and mannequin-like. This is a reviewed partial asset, not a photorealistic or human-likeness certification.
visualAssessment.remainingV3: The preview pair remains 17/23 applicable required checks and 0/5 recommended checks. Face shapes, regional texture density, teeth/gums/tongue/scalp, authored skin weights/contact, anatomical and optical calibration, compression/LOD and cross-device gates remain open.

rawFormatReports.retention: Ignored local artifacts; compact hashes and counts are committed in format-summary.json.
